memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “The Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.”  Luke 19:10

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
"Shechem" means shoulder, responsibility, obedience. Jacob’s sons were commanded to pasture the flocks there, the place of duty. Yet they wandered to "Dothan", meaning two wells, symbolizing comfort, distraction, and self-directed decisions. Their choice shows how a drifting heart slowly moves away from the father’s will.
Joseph, however, walked in full obedience. He went to "Shechem" first, and when he did not find his brothers, he searched earnestly until he reached "Dothan". His persistence showed love, commitment, and faithfulness to his father’s voice.

This is a picture of Jesus Christ. Just as Joseph searched for his brothers, Jesus came searching for sinners. Joseph was hated for his love, and Jesus was hated for His love. Joseph was plotted against, and Jesus was plotted against. Yet both fulfilled the Father’s will.

Let us remain in Shechem, the place of obedience, and not wander into Dothan, the place where hearts drift away. Obedience in small daily things prayer, truth, forgiveness, kindness  keeps us close to God’s will.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “Obedience is the door through which God pours His blessings.”  Charles Spurgeon

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me remain in Shechem, the place of obedience and responsibility. Keep my heart from wandering into Dothan. Give me Joseph’s spirit of love, perseverance, and faithfulness, and make me reflect Christ’s obedience in all I do. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the Lord strengthen your steps in obedience.
May His grace keep your heart steady in His will.
